generate_difference_report: generate a difference report comparing two benchmark JSON runs with optional color output
calculate_change: calculate the decimal change between an old value and a new value
color_format: format a string with BenchmarkColor objects that can be toggled on or off
find_longest_name: find the length of the longest benchmark name in a list of benchmark JSON objects
create_BenchmarkColor: create a BenchmarkColor instance with a name and ANSI escape code for terminal output
